name: Auto Pilot 4 Agents Unlocked
author: oliwier-xiao
description: Unlocked edition, with Auto and Full access levels. Write a prompt now and send it later to a Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor Agent or Pi session: in a few minutes, at a clock time, or right after a usage limit resets. Each job runs headless in a transient systemd user timer, so it fires while the screen is locked.

barWidget.description: Scheduled prompts for your coding agents, with a countdown to the next one.

schema.label: Next to the bar icon
schema.description: Next run shows the countdown to the soonest armed job. Queued count shows how many jobs are armed. Nothing leaves the icon alone.
